desc:
PLEASE WATCH THE FOLLOWING TUTORIALS:
Official Developer-made Tutorial:
Tall Oak Stables on Youtube

Tester-made Tutorial:
"OCS Alpha Test Tutorial [ Roblox ]" by Pixel Pony Club

This game is *VERY UNFINISHED*, please report any bugs you find so we can improve! <3
We love you guys, thank you so much for making this possible. You are AMAZING!!

~CONTROLS~

Z represents a "cluck", and X represents "woah"
Q is applying your left leg, and E is applying your right leg
W is applying both legs/squeezing, and S is like pulling the reins

~CREDITS~

Thank you so, so much to the generous Dana from Lakeside Saddlery, a Sims CC Creator. She kindly permitted us to use her assets. In our game, you'll see the following assets from her:

Western saddle
Breastplate
Martingales
Western bridles 
Bits
Scoot boots 
All halters 
Fleece pads
Western blanket
Cinches
Western stirrups
Hair

This game couldn't have been made without her generosity <3 Check out her website to see more of her amazing creations!
